description:
We are actively seeking a dedicated and experienced Director of Nursing (DON) to lead the clinical team at a premier health and rehabilitation center in Mediapolis, IA. This pivotal leadership role offers the opportunity to shape the quality of patient care and foster a supportive environment for both residents and staff. We are looking for a compassionate leader who is ready to make an immediate impact.

As the Director of Nursing, you will be responsible for overseeing all nursing operations, ensuring the highest standards of care, and maintaining compliance with all regulatory requirements. This role is ideal for an RN with proven leadership capabilities who is passionate about geriatric care and committed to clinical excellence. Join a team that values your expertise and dedication.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in the state of Iowa.
Minimum of 2-3 years of experience in a nursing leadership role, preferably as a Director of Nursing or Assistant Director of Nursing.
Prior experience in a skilled nursing or long-term care facility.
Demonstrated knowledge of state and federal regulations governing long-term care.
Strong clinical assessment, leadership, and communication skills.
